art_direction: 蜂鸟悬停于倒挂金钟花间，羽毛与花瓣细节围绕中心亮点展开，背景深绿安静。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Place a small hummingbird in profile near the center, hovering beside two pendulous fuchsia flowers. Its curved beak approaches one pale inner petal while the wings form translucent overlapping fans. Work in emerald, petrol blue, raspberry, and cream, with restrained metallic-looking feather iridescence created by painted color rather than glitter. The flowers hang from a curved stem that partly surrounds the bird without forming a complete wreath. Keep the deep forest-green background softly simplified. Describe layered throat feathers, tiny flower stamens, and the thin stems with care, concentrating detail around the bird and nearest bloom. Preserve a clear silhouette and an open lower corner for the square avatar crop.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
